worlds.name: Forest Realm
worlds.description: Lush green woodlands, mossy platforms, and bouncy slime creatures.

stages.title: Forest Fringe
stages.description: Edge of the Whispering Woods with simple jumps and coin rewards.

stages.title: Whispering Canopy
stages.description: Climb high tree branches and dodge wild slimes.

stages.title: Thicket Path
stages.description: Dense foliage requiring precise double jumps and coin collection.

stages.title: Swamp Edge
stages.description: Moist ground near swamp waters with aggressive slime elite guards.

stages.title: Whispering Woods Core
stages.description: The heart of the forest where the giant King Slime reigns supreme!

worlds.name: Mystic Ruins
worlds.description: Ancient stone colosseums, crumbling pillars, and goblin archer snipers.

stages.title: Outpost Ruins
stages.description: Outer perimeter of the ancient ruined fortress.

stages.title: Stone Corridor
stages.description: Tight corridors filled with stone archers and spikes.

stages.title: Ancient Courtyard
stages.description: Open ruins courtyard with airborne platforms and snipers.

stages.title: Collapse Chamber
stages.description: Chamber with unstable floors and goblin ambushes.

stages.title: Sanctum of the Fire Golem
stages.description: Face the mighty Fire Golem in the central inner sanctum!

worlds.name: Glacial Frost
worlds.description: Sub-zero glacial fortresses with slippery platforms and freezing blizzards.

stages.title: Frost Pass
stages.description: Slippery mountain pass with ice hazards.

stages.title: Glacial Ridge
stages.description: High altitude frozen peaks with sharp icicles.

stages.title: Snow Cavern
stages.description: Subterranean ice caves with crystal formations.

stages.title: Frozen Fortress
stages.description: Outer courtyard of the Frost Wyvern's icy citadel.

stages.title: Frozen Citadel Summit
stages.description: Challenge the terrifying Frost Wyvern atop the glacial citadel!

worlds.name: Shadow Realm
worlds.description: Dark nether domain populated by soul flames, shadow demons, and dark energy.

stages.title: Nether Gate
stages.description: Entrance to the shadowy nether dimension.

stages.title: Soul Road
stages.description: Path illuminated by eerie purple soul flames.

stages.title: Gloom Abyss
stages.description: Floating platforms above an infinite shadowy void.

stages.title: Dark Corridor
stages.description: Labyrinthine passage with teleporting shadow monsters.

stages.title: Shadow Abyss Throne
stages.description: Confront the Shadow Overlord in the heart of the void!

worlds.name: Celestial Temple
worlds.description: Sacred mountain temple featuring thunderbolts and divine dragon traps.

stages.title: Temple Entrance
stages.description: Golden stairs leading to the celestial shrine.

stages.title: Sacred Steps
stages.description: Lightning strike zones along ancient stone steps.

stages.title: Thunder Hall
stages.description: Vast hall with thunderbolts raining from above.

stages.title: Divine Passage
stages.description: Guarded by celestial elite sentinels.

stages.title: Celestial Dragon Shrine
stages.description: Slay the divine Primordial Dragon King at the altar!

worlds.name: Ocean Abyss
worlds.description: Submerged oceanic trench featuring water currents, anchors, and giant marine bosses.

stages.title: Sunken Coral Reefs
stages.description: Shallow ocean reefs with swimming currents and pearls.

stages.title: Coral Passage
stages.description: Narrow aquatic tunnels guarded by razor shellfish.

stages.title: Anchor Ruins & Traps
stages.description: Sunken ship anchors and whirlpool trap hazards.

stages.title: Trench Channel
stages.description: Dark ocean trench with pressurized currents.

stages.title: Abyss Sanctuary Lair
stages.description: Face the mighty Killer Whale in the depths of the ocean!

worlds.name: Volcanic Mountain
worlds.description: Raging lava rivers, fiery geysers, and molten rock elementals.

stages.title: Lava Ridge
stages.description: Outer mountain slopes with pools of liquid magma.

stages.title: Basalt Path
stages.description: Jagged dark volcanic stone path above lava.

stages.title: Magma Tunnel
stages.description: Underground lava tubes with erupting fire columns.

stages.title: Fiery Cavern
stages.description: Large cavern surrounded by boiling magma pools.

stages.title: Volcanic Peak Caldera
stages.description: Fight the fierce Magma Guard inside the volcano crater!

worlds.name: Primordial Core
worlds.description: Deep planetary core with landmines, exploding fire torrents, and heavy artillery.

stages.title: Subterranean Gate
stages.description: The deepest elevator shaft down to the core.

stages.title: Magma Channel
stages.description: Intense radiation and magma blasts in narrow tunnels.

stages.title: Flame Core
stages.description: Central energy grid with landmines and explosive traps.

stages.title: Explosion Vault
stages.description: Deep vault where heat waves explode continuously.

stages.title: Core Reactor Chamber
stages.description: Defeat the ancient Core Guardian before the core melts down!

worlds.name: Gladiator's Arena
worlds.description: Roman Colosseum survival arena! Endless waves spawn for 3 full minutes.

stages.title: Roman Colosseum Defense
stages.description: Survive the 180s wave defense timer to spawn the Exit Portal!

worlds.name: Sky Heavens
worlds.description: Floating cloud islands, high-altitude trampolines, and airborne grenadiers.

stages.title: High Clouds
stages.description: Floating white clouds above the world.

stages.title: Sky Passage
stages.description: High altitude wind currents and cloud trampolines.

stages.title: Celestial Isle
stages.description: Ancient sky sanctuary with floating islands.

stages.title: Wind Sanctuary
stages.description: High atmospheric winds and heavy artillery snipers.

stages.title: Heavens Apex Lair
stages.description: Banish the Demonic Grenadier from the top of the sky!

worlds.name: Cosmic Space & Moon
worlds.description: Deep outer space and the Lunar Palace. Massive drops, alien snipers, and cosmic wisps!

stages.title: Cosmic Boundary
stages.description: Low gravity void with drifting antimatter fields.

stages.title: Asteroid Belt
stages.description: Dodging falling meteors and alien snipers.

stages.title: Lunar Approach
stages.description: Approaching the glowing surface of the silver Moon.

stages.title: Outerspace Sphere
stages.description: Antimatter black hole gravity traps and giant wisp sentinels.

stages.title: Lunar Palace Sanctuary
stages.description: The ultimate supreme boss battle against the Giant Wisp & Lunar Goddess!
